title: Tell a conductor when panes are sitting idle
done_when: A conductor that has panes sitting idle is told so, on a call it already makes, naming the idle panes rather than repeating generic advice. It stays quiet below a minimum idle count, below a minimum quiet period, and repeats no more often than a fixed interval, so it does not become wallpaper. Unmerged prior art exists on feat/wait-and-nudge (fb1f041): idle_pane_nudge and nudge_is_due are written and tested there and can be lifted; only the wait_for_tasks half of that branch was taken.
